name: omnisense/omnidrive
description: Omnidrive: one contract for reading and writing files wherever they are kept - a directory of this machine, an S3 bucket, an SFTP (SSH) or FTP server - by the name the application gives each storage; Flysystem is the engine behind it, never in its signatures.

suggest.omnidrive/s3: An S3 bucket: AWS, MinIO, Scaleway, OVH, Cloudflare R2... (league/flysystem-async-aws-s3)
suggest.omnidrive/sftp: An SFTP server, over SSH (league/flysystem-sftp-v3, phpseclib)
suggest.omnidrive/ftp: An FTP or FTPS server (league/flysystem-ftp, ext-ftp)
suggest.league/flysystem-memory: Omnidrive\Testing\InMemoryDriveFactory: a drive in memory for an application's tests
